accepted_claims: A finite exact-rational positive-volume box-union cutter subtype now has an executable exact fixed-axis stationary/line/polyline sweep route using one shared source parameter across XYZ; nonconvex/reentrant regions are preserved as a union rather than replaced by a hull or AABB.

The bounded route applies to mill_form and mill_accessible_undercut instances representable by the reviewed codec and to local lathe_form_tool cutting/holder geometry without claiming the later lathe spindle/timed process sweep.

Accessible-undercut physical validity has an explicit deterministic witness that checks the complete cutting plus non-cutting holder body against retained-material/fixture obstacles along an unengaged approach path; candidate success is not the access oracle.

The exact axis-parallel slice agrees with the independently pinned MC-010 rational box-sweep oracle, while simultaneous-XYZ, reentrant-void, signed-neighbour and holder-only collision controls reject common simplifying corruptions.

MC-058-derived nonlinear leaves are consumed through conservative per-box inner/outer translation sandwiches and explicit INSIDE/OUTSIDE/UNCERTIFIED outcomes; an unresolved shell is never promoted to exact membership or topology truth.
open_claims: PB-007-03 remains OPEN: the admitted domain still lacks a universal finite exact source codec for arbitrary form/undercut cutting-region instances; the bounded box-union subtype does not narrow the frozen denominator.
Lathe rotational reduction and spindle/feed/timed process semantics for lathe_form_tool remain owned by MC-021 and MC-022; MC-020 does not claim them from the local cutter codec.
PO-02 remains OPEN: MC-020 contributes only a bounded form/undercut cutter/access slice rather than every admitted actual tool sweep.
PO-04, PO-05 and PO-06 remain OPEN: universal classification, finite progress and the complete source-to-engineering-output certificate chain are not established here.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject binary-floating correctness authority and global epsilon equality
reject enclosing AABB/convex-hull substitution and filling of reentrant cutter voids

reject unbound MC-058 nonlinear leaves, zeroing their enclosure, or promoting UNCERTIFIED shell points
reject deletion of retraces or engaged teleportation
reject promotion of the bounded box-union subtype into a universal arbitrary-form source codec
reject promotion of local lathe_form_tool geometry into completed rotational/timed lathe sweep semantics
reject dependency/oracle drift, closure of PB-007-03, model-to-native promotion and premature MC-B acceptance

review.disposition: completed bounded form/nonconvex/accessible-undercut construction for an exact-rational box-union cutter subtype, with independent axis-parallel control and explicit complete-body access witness
review.downstream_release: MC-028/MC-029/MC-030 and later integration work may consume the bounded construction while retaining PB-007-03; MC-021/MC-022 remain responsible for lathe process semantics

downstream_invalidations: Any semantic change to the MC-A form/undercut cutter families or MC-058 source/enclosure contract invalidates the corresponding MC-020 source-binding claim and requires prospective review.

Any downstream implementation that replaces the cutter union by an AABB/hull, fills a reentrant void, drops holder/non-cutting geometry from required access checks, loses shared XYZ source correlation, deletes retraces or permits engaged teleportation invalidates the affected sweep/access claim.

Any claim that exact_rational_box_union_v1 covers every admitted arbitrary form/undercut source instance, or any closure of PB-007-03 without a separate universal codec argument, invalidates this bounded disposition.
Any promotion of UNCERTIFIED bounded-leaf regions to exact membership/topology truth, or any reuse of candidate geometry as the independent MC-010 control, invalidates the claimed construction.
Future native-kernel evidence may supplement this deterministic construction but must not rewrite its recorded evidence class.
